# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates

trigger:

      - develop
      - master

jobs:
- job: unlock_state
  displayName: Unlock Terraform State
  pool: $(jobPool)
  steps:
  - task: DownloadSecureFile@1
    displayName: Download certificate
    name: cert
    inputs:
      secureFile: cert_mesx_${{ parameters.env }}.pfx

  - task: TerraformInstaller@0
    displayName: Install Terraform
    inputs:
      terraformVersion: '1.10.5'

  - task: TerraformTaskV3@3
    displayName: Terraform init
    inputs:
      provider: azurerm
      command: init
      commandOptions: -backend-config=use_azuread_auth=true
      workingDirectory: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      backendServiceArm: spn-${{ parameters.env }}-inf-mes
      ${{ if eq(parameters.env, 'dev') }}:
        backendAzureRmResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-static-01
        backendAzureRmStorageAccountName: stasgptmpxn01static01
      ${{ elseif or(eq(parameters.env, 'ppr'), eq(parameters.env, 'qua')) }}:
        backendAzureRmResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxp01-ppr-eun-static-01
        backendAzureRmStorageAccountName: stasgptmpxp01static02
      ${{ else }}:
        backendAzureRmResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxp01-pro-euw-static-01
        backendAzureRmStorageAccountName: stasgptmpxp01static03
      backendAzureRmContainerName: tfstates
      backendAzureRmKey: mpx-app-mes-${{ parameters.env }}.tfstate

  - task: TerraformTaskV3@3
    displayName: Terraform unlock
    inputs:
      provider: 'azurerm'
      command: 'custom'
      commandOptions: '-force ${{ parameters.lockId }}'
      outputTo: 'console'
      customCommand: 'force-unlock'
      environmentServiceNameAzureRM: spn-${{ parameters.env }}-inf-mes
      workingDirectory: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)

        -var=WK_INTEGRATION_PASSWORD="$(WK_INTEGRATION_PASSWORD)"
        -var=WK_BUFFER_RETENTION_DAYS="$(WK_BUFFER_RETENTION_DAYS)"

      ${{ else }}:
        environmentServiceNameAzureRM: spn-${{ parameters.env }}-inf-mes
  
  - ${{ if eq(parameters.runMigrationJobs, true) }}:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: Run All Database Migration Jobs
      inputs:
        ${{ if eq(parameters.env, 'qua') }}:
          azureSubscription: spn-ppr-inf-mes
        ${{ else }}:
          azureSubscription: spn-${{ parameters.env }}-inf-mes
        scriptType: 'pscore'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          $env = '${{ parameters.env }}'
          if ($env -eq 'dev') {
            $rg = 'rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01'
          } elseif ($env -eq 'ppr') {
            $rg = 'rg-gptmpxp01-ppr-eun-mes-01'
          } elseif ($env -eq 'pro') {
            $rg = 'rg-gptmpxp01-pro-euw-mes-01'
          } else {
            $rg = 'rg-gptmpxp01-qua-eun-mes-01'
          }

          $WaitingDelayInSeconds = ${{ parameters.migrationsWaitingDelayInSeconds }}
          $RetryCount = ${{ parameters.migrationWaitingRetryCount }}

          $resources = az resource list -g $rg -o json `
            | ConvertFrom-Json

          $migrationsJobs = $resources `
              | Where-Object {
                  $_.name.EndsWith('-dbm') -and ($_.type -eq 'Microsoft.App/jobs')
              }

          Write-Output 'The following jobs will be triggered:'
          $migrationsJobs | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "- $($_.name)" }

          Write-Output 'Triggering Migration Jobs...'
          $jobExecutions = $migrationsJobs `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  $executionName = az containerapp job start `
                      -n $_.name `
                      -g $rg `
                      --query name -o tsv
                  return [PSCustomObject]@{
                      JobName = $_.name
                      ResourceGroupName = $rg
                      ExecutionName = $executionName
                  }     
              }

          Write-Output 'Start Waiting Jobs...'
          $waitingJobs = $jobExecutions `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  Start-Job -Name $_.ExecutionName `
                      -ScriptBlock { 
                          param(
                              $jobExec,
                              $delay,
                              $retryCount
                          )

                          function Get-JobExecutionStatus {
                              param(
                                  $JobExecution
                              )
                          
                              return az containerapp job execution show `
                                  -n $JobExecution.JobName `
                                  -g $JobExecution.ResourceGroupName `
                                  --job-execution-name $JobExecution.ExecutionName `
                                  --query properties.status -o tsv
                          }
                          
                          function Wait-JobCompletion {
                              param(
                                  $JobExecution,
                                  $DelaySeconds,
                                  $RetryCount,
                                  $SuccessStatus = 'Succeeded',
                                  $WaitingStatuses = @('Unknown', 'Running')
                              )
                          
                              $jobStatus = Get-JobExecutionStatus $JobExecution
                          
                              while ($WaitingStatuses.Contains($jobStatus) -and ($RetryCount -gt 0)) {
                                  Write-Output "$(Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss') - Running, remaining retries $RetryCount..."
                                  Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
                                  $jobStatus = Get-JobExecutionStatus $JobExecution
                                  $RetryCount -= 1
                              }


                              if ($jobstatus -ne $SuccessStatus) {
                                  throw "Migration Job did not complete successfully or timed out, status: $jobStatus, remaining retries: $RetryCount"
                              }
                            
                              Write-Output "Migration Job '$($JobExecution.ExecutionName)' completed successfully !"
                          }

                          Wait-JobCompletion $jobExec $delay $retryCount
                      } `
                      -ArgumentList $_, $WaitingDelayInSeconds, $RetryCount
              }

          $waitingJobs `
              | ForEach-Object {
                  Write-Output "$($_.Name) output:"
                  Receive-Job $_ -Wait
              }

  # - ${{ if and( eq(parameters.command, 'apply'), ne(parameters.env, 'dev')) }}:

trigger: none

parameters:
- name: env
  displayName: Environment
  values:
  - dev
  - ppr
  - pro

- name: address
  displayName: Terraform resource address

- name: id
  displayName: Azure resource ID

jobs:
- deployment: deploy
  pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss

  environment: app_cloud_${{ parameters.env }}_mes

  variables:
  - template: .devops/vars_${{ parameters.env }}.yml
  - group: app_cloud_${{ parameters.env }}_mes

  strategy:
    runOnce:
      deploy:
        steps:
        - checkout: self

        - task: TerraformInstaller@0
          displayName: Install Terraform
          inputs:
            terraformVersion: latest

        - task: TerraformTaskV3@3
          displayName: Terraform init
          inputs:
            provider: azurerm
            command: init
            commandOptions: -backend-config=use_azuread_auth=true
            workingDirectory: deploy
            backendServiceArm: spn-${{ parameters.env }}-inf-mes
            ${{ if eq(parameters.env, 'dev') }}:
              backendAzureRmResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-static-01
              backendAzureRmStorageAccountName: stasgptmpxn01static01
            ${{ elseif or(eq(parameters.env, 'ppr'), eq(parameters.env, 'qua')) }}:
              backendAzureRmResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxp01-ppr-eun-static-01
              backendAzureRmStorageAccountName: stasgptmpxp01static02
            ${{ else }}:
              backendAzureRmResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxp01-pro-euw-static-01
              backendAzureRmStorageAccountName: stasgptmpxp01static03
            backendAzureRmContainerName: tfstates
            backendAzureRmKey: mpx-app-mes-${{ parameters.env }}.tfstate

        - task: TerraformTaskV3@3
          displayName: Terraform import
          inputs:
            provider: azurerm
            command: custom
            workingDirectory: terraform
            customCommand: import
            commandOptions: >
              -input=false
              -var=DATAHUB_API_PASSWORD=NO_NEED_TO_PROVIDE
              -var=SPN_SECRET=NO_NEED_TO_PROVIDE
              ${{ parameters.address }}
              ${{ parameters.id }}
            outputTo: console
            environmentServiceNameAzureRM: spn-${{ parameters.env }}-inf-mes

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md
    - _service_versions.json

variables:
  isPR: $[eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')]
  triggeredOnTag: $[and(eq(variables.isPR, false), startsWith(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/tags/'))]
  triggeredOnMain: $[and(eq(variables.isPR, false), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranchName'], 'main'))]
  previewInDev: $[eq(variables.isPR, true)]
  deployToDev: $[and(eq(variables.isPR, false), eq(variables.triggeredOnTag, false))]
  deployToPro: $[eq(variables.triggeredOnTag, true)]

pool: ubuntu-2204-vmss-mesx

stages:

# PR validation: Preview changes in DEV

- stage: preview_dev
  displayName: Preview in DEV
  condition: eq(variables.previewInDev, true)
  jobs:
  - job: preview_dev
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_dev.yml
    - group: app_cloud_dev_mes
    steps:
    - template: .devops/terraform.yml
      parameters:
        env: dev
        command: plan
        runMigrationJobs: false

# Continuous integration: Deploy to DEV

- stage: deploy_dev
  displayName: Deploy to DEV
  dependsOn: []
  condition: eq(variables.deployToDev, true)
  jobs:
  - deployment: deploy_dev
    environment: app_cloud_dev_mes
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_dev.yml
    - group: app_cloud_dev_mes
    workspace:
      clean: all
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - template: .devops/terraform.yml
            parameters:
              env: dev
              command: apply
              
# Deployment: Deploy to PPR 

- stage: preview_ppr
  displayName: Preview in PPR
  dependsOn: []
  condition: eq(variables.deployToPro, true)
  jobs:
  - job: preview_ppr
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_ppr.yml
    - group: app_cloud_ppr_mes
    steps:
    - template: .devops/terraform.yml
      parameters:
        env: ppr
        command: plan
        runMigrationJobs: false

- stage: deploy_ppr
  displayName: Deploy to PPR
  dependsOn: preview_ppr
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - deployment: deploy_ppr
    environment: app_cloud_ppr_mes
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_ppr.yml
    - group: app_cloud_ppr_mes
    workspace:
      clean: all
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - template: .devops/terraform.yml
            parameters:
              env: ppr
              command: apply

# QUA and PRO run in parallel after PPR

- stage: preview_qua
  displayName: Preview in QUA
  dependsOn: deploy_ppr
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: preview_qua
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_qua.yml
    - group: app_cloud_qua_mes
    steps:
    - template: .devops/terraform.yml
      parameters:
        env: qua
        command: plan
        runMigrationJobs: false

- stage: deploy_qua
  displayName: Deploy to QUA
  dependsOn: preview_qua
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - deployment: deploy_qua
    environment: app_cloud_qua_mes
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_qua.yml
    - group: app_cloud_qua_mes
    workspace:
      clean: all
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - template: .devops/terraform.yml
            parameters:
              env: qua
              command: apply

- stage: preview_pro
  displayName: Preview in PRO
  dependsOn: deploy_ppr
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: preview_pro
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_pro.yml
    - group: app_cloud_pro_mes
    steps:
    - template: .devops/terraform.yml
      parameters:
        env: pro
        command: plan
        runMigrationJobs: false

- stage: deploy_pro
  displayName: Deploy to PRO
  dependsOn: preview_pro
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - deployment: deploy_pro
    environment: app_cloud_pro_mes
    variables:
    - template: .devops/vars_pro.yml
    - group: app_cloud_pro_mes
    workspace:
      clean: all
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - template: .devops/terraform.yml
            parameters:
              env: pro
              command: apply
